name: Every difference is forecast against what someone saw
non_visual_rationale: Three generated laws over stored numbers and a stored prefix; the observable is fast-check's counterexample in terminal output, with no rendered surface at any point. U1-U8 and a Vera walk are therefore N/A.
criteria: Raising every forecast raises the difference the fit stores, because the difference is forecast minus observed.
Shuffling which person reported which morning changes nothing stored, because nobody has any history yet.
Reporting a bigger size lowers the stored difference.
blocker_resolution: The accepted roadmap records this step BLOCKED AND NOT PLANNABLE TO GREEN, on the third criterion. That blocker is a property of ONE cucumber fixture builder, syntheticMornings on recover/learning-build, which computes forecastEffectiveHeightM = bandMid(band) - biggerThanForecastM + deviation and therefore moves the forecast with the reported band, cancelling r_height exactly. That helper does not exist on this branch, and the roadmap names the fix itself: decouple the forecast from the reported band. This step's own fixture holds the prediction row FIXED while only the reported band moves, which is that fix. Nothing was weakened: no assertion was softened, no feature file or shared fixture was edited, and no band-sensitive residual was implemented - the roadmap forbids all three, and the third would contradict 06 section 5.1 and red the sealed 01-08 and 01-13 oracles. Measured directly through the port: mid(head_overhead) - mid(chest_head) = 0.65 m, and with the forecast fixed the stored difference falls by exactly that.
acceptance: Twenty generated cases drive four isolated runLearningFitOnce executions each over 10-30 mornings from 5-7 people. Baseline; every prediction row lifted 0.05-0.5 m with the reports untouched; the reported band raised chest_head to head_overhead with the forecast held fixed; and the device assignment rotated over the same set of people. The oracle asserts the stored difference rises by exactly the forecast lift, falls by exactly the band-midpoint rise derived from src/data/size-bands.ts, and that the whole stored record is byte-identical under the reporter shuffle. It rejects three controlled mutations, one per law.
red_evidence: src/learning/residuals.ts was mutated to subtract a fixed reference midpoint instead of mid(band_i) - the naive alternative the roadmap names. The 01-18 acceptance failed semantically ('the drop must be exactly the rise in reported midpoint 0.6499999999999999; it was 2.7755575615628914e-17'), together with the pre-existing residual-form unit law. The mutation was reverted and `git diff --stat src/` confirmed empty before the gate was re-run.
scope_note: The roadmap lists tests/unit/learning-residual-laws.test.ts among files_to_modify. No unit law was added: that file already carries 'the residual form is r_height = H_eff_pred - mid(band)' quantified over every band and swell height, which entails both the forecast-monotonicity and band-anti-monotonicity laws, and the reporter-shuffle determinism is already carried by 01-15's emitter law. Adding mirrors would be test duplication rather than coverage.
